integrity: The proof is symbolic and uses only quotient homomorphisms, persistence of equality with the identity, and standard finite-abelian subgroup facts; no computational search is used as proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is an obstruction to \(\mathsf{S4.3}\), not a complete computation of parameter-validities.
No converse is claimed for groups whose normal-subgroup lattice is a chain.
The construction gives pairwise future-incompatible reachable states, not the stronger globally independent-button family used in exact \(\mathsf{S4.2}\) arguments.
title: Normal-subgroup antichains force homomorphic modal branching
